parallel.requirements: Recognized all ten requirement slugs covering A1 supervised learning, A3 clustering/dimensionality reduction, and A4 forest MDP functions with exact public signatures and non-empty git patches.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Round 1 parent implemented a1_sl_util and a1_sl_decision_tree directly, launched a workflow for the remaining modules, then round 2 inherited two completed and eight remaining requirements and took over final completion.
parallel.implementation: Final parallel code covered supervised classifiers, weighted ROC-AUC utilities, clustering metrics, dimensionality reduction plots, PI/VI forest behavior, generated all ten requirement patches, and removed visible stubs.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Round 2 committed all ten non-empty requirement patch files, consolidated the shared workspace, and delivered a tree that official LoopsBench marked resolved.
parallel.verification: Parallel ran exact signature checks, a full 115-test agent suite, end-to-end driver checks, and official tests that all passed.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The first workflow round was interrupted with only two requirements credited; after round 2 no official unresolved implementation gap remained.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same ten requirement slugs and exact signatures, with no delegation permitted by the serial control settings.
serial.plan_and_ownership: One agent handled implementation, tests, fixes, patch refresh, and commits sequentially in a single round.
serial.implementation: Serial implemented all major A1, A3, and A4 modules, added regression tests, fixed numpy object dtype, adjusted heatmap midpoint handling, and refreshed requirement patches from the final diff.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial tree showed a broad final diff and non-empty patches for all ten requirements, but the run ended under agent_timeout before an accepted final response/evaluation result.
serial.verification: Serial ran its local regression test file successfully with 19 passed, but official final_test_results remained null because the agent timed out.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No specific remaining code defect is proven from the reviewed trajectory; the official failure is the timeout/closure state with no accepted final official tests.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run saw the same ten required slugs and exact public signatures, then the second round recorded all ten requirements complete.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run saw the same ten required slugs and recorded all ten complete before timeout.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No task-requirement misunderstanding explains the discordance; both attempts targeted all ten obligations, but only parallel reached an official passing closure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel parent implemented util and decision tree itself, launched a workflow for the remaining modules, then round 2 took ownership of the leftover requirements.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run had workflows and delegation tools disabled and proceeded through the implementation as one local agent.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had child ownership plus later parent takeover, while serial had single-agent ownership and no child work to join or cancel.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel workflow was briefed with the shared task context and per-module work, and round 2 received a progress checkpoint naming the completed and remaining slugs.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial actor carried the full prompt context locally and inspected/edited the same requirement files and implementation modules in one workspace.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No retained context-loss or interface-contract error is proven; the material parallel context event is that unfinished state was available to the recovery round.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The passing parallel path produced all ten requirement patches and checked exact A1/A3/A4 signatures plus functional behavior.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial path also implemented all major modules, fixed numpy object dtype, adjusted heatmap midpoint behavior, refreshed patches, and produced a broad final diff.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both paths made substantial complete-looking implementations; the decisive difference is delivery/closure, not a clearly missing serial function.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The round-1 parallel workflow was stopped before active children finalized, and the first outer loop ended with eight requirements still remaining.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no delegated child result lifecycle; it locally completed work and tests before the agent timeout ended the round.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Only parallel exhibits an adverse child-result lifecycle episode, but it was later recovered and did not decide the final official pass/fail relation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used a shared implementation workspace with workflow children, then parent/round-2 commits and final patch timeline consolidated the final tree.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used a single shared workspace without delegation and committed the final refreshed patch set from one agent.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel shared-state use was not proven to cause a collision or overwrite; the final integrated patch set was accepted, while serial integration was locally coherent but timed out.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran a 115-test agent suite and the official evaluation produced passed final test results.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran 19 local regression tests, but official evaluation recorded final_test_results null because the agent timed out.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel closed the loop with accepted official tests; serial had local checks but no official accepted final test set.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed one timed-out workflow round, then used a second official round to complete the remaining eight requirements and pass.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial spent one long sequential round and was terminated by the task agent timeout just after local completion activities.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The discordant outcome is best explained by closure budget: parallel received and used a recovery round; serial exhausted its single round before an accepted official result.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed status evaluation makes this a parallel_only_pass pair: parallel solution_passed is true, while serial solution_passed is false with failure_mode agent_timeout and final_test_results null. Process evidence shows parallel initially suffered a stopped workflow that left eight requirements for a second round, but that second round inherited the checkpoint, produced all ten patches, ran 115 local tests, and then passed the official tests. Serial did substantial single-agent work, locally passed 19 tests, refreshed all ten patches, and committed, but it exhausted the agent window before an accepted final closure, so the official harness recorded no final test results. The concrete difference is recovery and closure: parallel got from partial workflow state to accepted official evaluation, while serial reached local completion evidence but not an accepted official outcome.
parallel_contributors: A second parallel outer-loop round inherited the two completed slugs and eight remaining slugs from round 1.
Round 2 generated all ten non-empty requirement patches and ran a 115-test local suite before official evaluation passed.
serial_contributors: Serial ran without delegation and spent the single round on sequential implementation and fixes.
The serial agent timed out after local tests and patch refresh, leaving official final_test_results null and solution_passed false.
ordinary_implementation_differences: The reviewed evidence does not isolate a normal coding defect as the serial official failure; both trajectories show broad final implementations and local tests before closure.
evaluator_effects: The official outcome source is cell/status.json:evaluation; serial is unresolved because of agent_timeout, not because final official tests failed.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative contributors, not an exclusive root cause

candidates.reason: The parallel parent launched an executed workflow for the remaining modules, but that active workflow was stopped before its needed work and result were finalized. The live progress record still showed multiple workflow children in error or stalled states, and the outer-loop record credited only two of ten requirements after that round. A later round inherited the incomplete state and completed the remaining eight requirements, so this was an adverse parallel process event but not the reason the final parallel run failed.
candidates.realized_consequence: Round 1 closed with only a1_sl_decision_tree and a1_sl_util counted complete, leaving eight requirements for round 2 takeover and recovery before final acceptance.
candidates.near_match_reason: No Failure Takeover is the nearest rejected label, but the later parallel round did resume/take over the unfinished requirement set and completed all ten requirements before evaluation.
